name: fix_node_buffer_encoding
description: Fixes Buffer-to-string coercion that corrupts multi-byte utf8 text
prompts: combineFiles in combine.js reads files WITHOUT an encoding, so fs.readFileSync returns Buffers that get implicitly stringified during concatenation. That happens to work for ASCII but is the classic encoding bug: the function must read the files as utf8 text explicitly. Fix combine.js to read with the 'utf8' encoding (behavior otherwise unchanged: contents joined with a single newline between files, no trailing newline). Multi-byte characters like 'héllo → wörld' must come through intact.
